## Change type

## Verification

<!-- List commands and manual checks. Add before/after screenshots for visible changes. -->

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when the change affects a browser flow or visible interface

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] New behavior has the smallest useful regression test.
- [ ] New factual claims identify a primary or scholarly source and explain its use.
- [ ] Curriculum wording is original and model-neutral.
- [ ] Examples and artifacts contain no personal, confidential, health, student, customer, case, or authentication data.
- [ ] I considered keyboard use, screen readers, contrast, motion, zoom, and narrow viewports where relevant.
- [ ] I documented any effect on privacy, measurement claims, static hosting, or adapter boundaries.
- [ ] I agree to follow the project [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/edcadet10/brief-and-verify/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
